platform.title: A LARGE PLATFORM, WITH GROWTH THAT VARIES
platform.chartTitle: Combined Weixin and WeChat monthly activity
platform.chartText: The account base rose in every year shown, adding 149.8 million accounts overall. Annual gains still varied: 45.0 million in 2022, 29.8 million in 2023, 42.0 million in 2024 and 33.0 million in 2025. A rising total therefore need not mean an accelerating rate of expansion. Supplement A separates those annual additions from the platform level.

sections.heading: What does the large total measure?
sections.text: Tencent counts accounts active during the previous month, including messaging or activities such as Moments. The figures combine Weixin and WeChat, so they are not counts of distinct people or Chinese residents. The separate interim observation was 1,439 million at 30 June 2026. It provides a later snapshot, while the five year-end observations give a consistent basis for the annual growth comparison.

sections.heading: A planning question beyond reach
sections.text: Scale gives businesses and community groups context for potential reach. Our interpretation is that they should also examine what people do after joining a conversation: finding useful information, building relationships or withdrawing from active participation. A large account total does not show that a particular business can reach everyone, or that users benefit equally. The following studies address more specific outcomes in selected groups.

platform.source: Sources: Tencent Annual Reports 2022 and 2025, operating information p. 4; June 2026 Offering Circular, p. 16; Interim Report 2026, p. 5. Calculations use reported values and their original precision.
platform.zhTitle: 平台规模：用户基数很大，但增长不等于人人受益
platform.zhRead: 先看规模与变化，再看统计口径：折线统计的是微信与 WeChat 合计活跃账号，不是独立人数。2026 年 6 月的数值单独注明，没有混进年末趋势。

commerce.title: PERCEIVED VALUE IS LINKED TO REPEAT BUYING INTENT
commerce.chartSub: 514 WeChat shoppers in China · correlation coefficient r
commerce.chartHeading: Practical value and enjoyment stand out
commerce.chartText: Utilitarian value describes practical benefits; hedonic value describes enjoyment. Their displayed correlations exceed those for recommendations, feedback and interactivity. This points to questions about customers' shopping experience. The ordering does not establish statistically different correlations or show that changing a feature will increase purchases.

sections.heading: What does the ranking show?
sections.text: Guo and Li (2022) analysed 514 valid questionnaires from WeChat shoppers recruited through Sojump. Utilitarian value has the largest displayed correlation with repurchase intention, at 0.661, followed by hedonic value at 0.584. Table 4 reports these associations; Supplement B shows the two values within the structural model. The two views answer related questions, but a raw correlation and an adjusted model path are different statistics.

sections.heading: A service question for customer groups
sections.text: Our interpretation is that a business could examine whether its group gives customers useful answers and an enjoyable experience. Recommendations, feedback and opportunities to ask questions may be part of that investigation. The study measures intention rather than actual repeat sales. Its mainly young, university-educated participants and cross-sectional self-reports limit generalisation, so these ideas need testing with the intended customers before being treated as effective changes.

commerce.source: Source: Guo & Li (2022), Frontiers in Psychology, 12:775056, Table 4 and sample description. DOI: 10.3389/fpsyg.2021.775056. Original off-diagonal correlations; no significance markers added.
commerce.zhTitle: 商业影响：有用、愉快的购物体验与复购意愿有关
commerce.zhRead: 这张比较 5 个因素与复购意愿的相关程度。右侧保留研究方法、商业含义与局限；复购意愿不能写成已经发生的订单或营业额。

connection.title: DIFFERENT INTERACTIONS RELATE TO DIFFERENT TIES
connection.chartTitle: Communication patterns and later social capital
connection.chartSub: Two-wave China panel · standardized model coefficient β
connection.chartHeading: Close support and broader connections differ
connection.chartText: Bonding measures close-tie support and trust; bridging measures resources from wider connections. Neither counts friends. Filled markers indicate reported significance; open markers retain all four nonsignificant paths. A nonsignificant result does not prove no relationship.

sections.heading: Different activities, different resources
sections.text: Likes, comments and private interaction were positively associated with later bonding. Posting and revisiting content were associated with bridging. In Zhang and Jung's (2023) two-wave panel, the coefficients for private interaction and bonding, and for posting and bridging, were 0.14 and 0.13 respectively. The pattern draws attention to how people use the platform, rather than treating all activity as the same kind of connection.

sections.heading: Choose a routine, then assess it
sections.text: Our interpretation is that a group should match its communication routine to its purpose, then check whether participants find it useful. The study collected data in January–May 2020, three months apart, retaining 740 of 1,202 respondents (61.56%). Its model accounts for prior levels and selected covariates, but observation and participant loss leave alternative explanations. A nonsignificant path is not proof that no relationship exists.

connection.source: Source: Zhang & Jung (2023), Journal of Computer-Mediated Communication, 28(1), zmac030; Structural model section and Figure 2. DOI: 10.1093/jcmc/zmac030. All eight focal paths are shown.
connection.zhTitle: 社会影响：维系熟人与扩展联系，用法并不一样
connection.zhRead: 蓝色表示熟人之间的支持，橙色表示更广泛联系带来的资源。实心点是论文报告显著的关系；空心点是不显著的关系，不能直接理解为“完全没影响”。

fatigue.title: OVERLOAD IS LINKED TO FATIGUE AND ANXIETY
fatigue.chartTitle: Which pressures relate to fatigue and anxiety?
fatigue.chartSub: 836 WeChat users in China · standardized model paths β

sections.heading: The strongest associations differ
sections.text: In Liu et al.'s (2024) model, social overload has the largest displayed fatigue coefficient, at 0.301. Information overload has the largest anxiety coefficient, at 0.228. The outcomes therefore show different numerical patterns within the same sample of 836 Chinese WeChat users, surveyed in January–February 2024. These rankings describe the fitted model; they do not establish significant differences between coefficients or show which pressure causes the most harm.

sections.heading: A practical response needs testing
sections.text: Fatigue and anxiety were associated with lurking, with coefficients of 0.291 and 0.126. Lurking means observing content without active participation, which differs from leaving the platform. Our interpretation is to trial clearer reply expectations and fewer repeated notices in a group. The cross-sectional self-report survey cannot establish that overload caused lurking or that those routines would help. Any improvement should be assessed through actual participant feedback.

fatigue.source: Source: Liu, Feng, Chen & Yuan (2024), Frontiers in Psychology, 15:1406895, Section 5.3 and Figure 2. DOI: 10.3389/fpsyg.2024.1406895. All displayed paths: p < .01; no causal effects claimed.
fatigue.zhTitle: 负面影响：使用负担与疲劳、焦虑及潜水行为有关
fatigue.zhRead: 上面比较 5 类压力与两种感受的关系，下面看疲劳、焦虑与“只看不参与”的关系。图中 β 是模型系数，不是百分比，也不是因果证明。

growth.title: HOW FOUR YEARS ADD UP TO 149.8 MILLION
growth.sub: Cumulative net increase since 2021 · million combined active accounts
growth.caption: The four annual additions sum to 149.8 million accounts, an 11.8% increase from the 2021 base. The largest addition was 45.0 million in 2022; the smallest was 29.8 million in 2023. Each floating block adds one year's net change. This separates growth over the period from the platform's total size and does not identify the causes of growth.
growth.source: Tencent operating information; same annual observations as Figure 01. Derived differences, not new observations.
growth.zhTitle: 补充图 A：用瀑布图看四年增长如何累计
growth.zhRead: 浮动方块是各年净增加量，最右端是四年合计。纵轴表示相对2021年的累计增加，不是总活跃账号数；数据均从主图相邻年份相减得到。

value.title: TWO VALUE PATHS, ONE INTENTION OUTCOME
value.sub: Selected paths from Guo & Li's model · standardized coefficient β
value.caption: Practical benefits and enjoyment connect to the same intended outcome in the published model. The utilitarian-value coefficient is 0.485, compared with 0.284 for hedonic value; both have p < .001. These are selected model paths, distinct from the correlations in Figure 02. Their numerical ordering does not establish a significant difference between paths or an increase in actual sales.
value.source: Guo & Li (2022), Figure 2 and structural model results. DOI: 10.3389/fpsyg.2021.775056.
value.zhTitle: 补充图 B：两种价值如何连接到同一个复购意愿结果
value.zhRead: 路径图呈现论文选定的两条标准化关系。箭头表达模型中的方向，不代表因果已经得到证明；线宽一致，避免把系数误画成流量。

hours.title: DAILY TIME WITHIN THE FATIGUE-STUDY SAMPLE
hours.caption: The 2–4 hour category contains 374 respondents (44.7%), the largest share of this sample. Another 309 (37.0%) report under two hours. The ring describes how the survey sample is composed; it is not a national user profile. Retaining the original categories keeps the figure traceable, but these shares cannot establish a safe time limit or show that time alone caused fatigue.
hours.source: Liu et al. (2024), Table 1. Counts and percentages reproduced; category boundaries follow the published labels.
hours.zhTitle: 补充图 C：用环形图看836名被调查者的时长构成
hours.zhRead: 环形面积按照实际人数绘制，右侧同时列人数与论文占比。它描述论文样本，不是全国微信用户画像，也不用于推断安全使用时长。
